title: Weekly production plan
question: How much of each item should we make this week within oven, staff and flour limits?
story: The plan earns {objective} this week; {binding} limits are fully used.
questions: Which limit holds the plan back the most?
Which items does the plan cut, and why?

datasets.name: records
datasets.sql: SELECT o.record_key, o.entity_id, o.entity_label, o.priority_tier, o.`rank`, o.top_reasons, o.recommended_action, o.value, o.as_of_date, p.current_value, p.recommended_value, p.delta, p.objective_contribution, i.category, i.region, i.channel FROM main.supply.production_out AS o JOIN main.supply.production_out__plan AS p ON p.entity = o.entity_id JOIN main.supply.items AS i ON i.item_id = o.entity_id WHERE o.is_current AND o.change_source <> 'delete'

datasets.name: limits
datasets.sql: SELECT c.name, c.`limit`, c.used, c.slack, c.shadow_price FROM main.supply.production_out__constraints AS c

charts.title: How much of each limit the plan uses
charts.hint: The bar is what the plan uses; the frame is the limit. Red means the limit is fully used.
charts.so_what: A red limit caps the plan: raising it is the fastest way to earn more.

charts.title: What a 10% change in each limit is worth
charts.hint: Margin lost if the limit drops 10%, and gained if it rises 10%, at today's shadow prices.
charts.so_what: Spend first on the limit with the longest bar.

charts.title: Value of one more unit of each limit
charts.hint: The shadow price: how much margin one more unit of the limit adds.
charts.so_what: Compare it with what one more unit costs.

plan.title: Production plan
plan.hint: This week's run for each item next to the solver's plan. Accept a line, or override it with a reason.

records.title: Plan lines
records.hint: Items in this week's plan, ranked by the margin they add.
records.label: entity_label
